title: Actor Tom Skerritt, star of Alien, Top Gun and Picket Fences, dies at 93
dek: His death, reported by several outlets on Thursday, followed a career of seven decades across film and TV.
what: The Hollywood Reporter reported on Thursday 22 October that the actor Tom Skerritt has died at 93. CBS News, NPR, Deadline and other outlets reported the same.

CBS News says his publicist confirmed the death to it on Thursday, and that he died on Wednesday 21 October of natural causes. A family statement quoted by CBS says the world knew him for his acting and the family knew him for his humor, curiosity, wisdom and generosity.

CBS lists his best known roles: Captain Dallas in Alien, the flight instructor Viper in Top Gun, Sheriff Jimmy Brock in the TV drama Picket Fences, and the Rev. John Maclean in A River Runs Through It. He won the Emmy for lead actor in a drama series in 1993 for Picket Fences.
I did not open a statement from a studio or a guild. The account above rests on the outlets listed.
why: Skerritt appeared in films from several decades and genres, so people from different generations remember him for different roles. The coverage names Alien, Top Gun and Picket Fences, which reach three different audiences.
